**Diff review, hunk by hunk.**

- It sits after the untouched flag-OFF early return, so it is unreachable with the flag OFF.

- It follows the CancelledError and Exception arms, so it catches only KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit, GeneratorExit and custom BaseException subclasses.
- Python does not route an exception raised inside a sibling handler to this arm, so no double record is possible.
- The 8 new test nodes are outcome-level pins. The file already has an autouse socket guard and an autouse flag delenv, so the flag-OFF pin holds in every ambient flag state.
